name: NASDUCK
full_name: Noble and Alkali Spin Detectors for Ultralight Coherent darK matter
summary: A search for ultralight field dark matter using noble-gas nuclear spins and alkali-metal optical magnetometers.
detection_principle: Polarized xenon nuclei interact with the axion background, read out by a rubidium Floquet magnetometer; later SERF and triaxial magnetometers provide complementary noise rejection.

phases.description: 2026 dark-photon search using a triaxial magnetometer.

results.summary: New axion–proton and axion–neutron coupling constraints were obtained.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
